clue.text: Beholden for plenty of coal?

definitions.meaning: beholden means owing thanks, indebted to someone
a fireplace loaded with coal is a grate that is full, read as two words run together

explanation.definitionFit: Being beholden to someone means feeling thankful and indebted for their kindness.

clue.text: Bully Billy turned up, by the way

indicators.note: turned up in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: Billy Liar is the title character of the novel and film
a road is a way

explanation.surface: A bully named Billy appeared by the roadside.
explanation.walkthrough: BILLY LIAR is a 1959 English novel and film about a fantasist.
explanation.definitionFit: To railroad someone is to bully them into doing something.

clue.text: It's bound to take a trick, and to wake the dead

definitions.text: It's bound to take a trick
definitions.meaning: in card games the final remaining trump card must win a trick
in Christian belief a trumpet call at the end of the world raises the dead

explanation.definitionFit: The final trumpet blast of Judgement Day, and the final trump card in a hand.

clue.text: Dance company led by priest

indicators.note: led by in a down clue puts the second piece first

parts.note: a flamen was a priest in ancient Rome

explanation.surface: A dance troupe headed by a clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: Flamenco is a passionate Spanish dance.

clue.text: In due course almost everyone will be on side

parts.note: in due course means later

indicators.note: almost says the word loses its last letter

parts.note: everyone means all

explanation.surface: Eventually everybody will be on the team.
explanation.definitionFit: Lateral means at or on the side.

clue.text: Start to transfer sovereignty to an emperor

indicators.note: start to a word is its first letter

parts.note: the Raj was British sovereignty in India

explanation.surface: Beginning to hand over power to an emperor.
explanation.walkthrough: The RAJ was British rule over India.
explanation.definitionFit: Trajan was a Roman emperor.

clue.text: Long, hard journey starting to render everyone knackered

indicators.note: starting says take the opening letter of each following word

explanation.surface: A gruelling journey begins to leave everyone exhausted.
explanation.definitionFit: A trek is a long, arduous journey.

clue.text: Is a depth vital for anchorage?

indicators.note: vital in its sense of lively or full of life signals the letters are set moving into a new order

explanation.surface: Asks whether water depth matters for a place to drop anchor.
explanation.walkthrough: SPITHEAD is the stretch of the Solent off Portsmouth, a famous Royal Navy anchorage.
explanation.definitionFit: Spithead is a sheltered strait off Portsmouth where the fleet traditionally anchors.

clue.text: Publicises excursion and its starting point

parts.note: to publicise views is to air them, so publicises gives airs
an excursion is a trip

explanation.surface: Someone advertises an outing and says where it sets off from.
explanation.definitionFit: A runway is where a flight, a kind of excursion, begins, so it is that trip's starting point.

clue.text: Glue or nail missing end in place

indicators.note: this word says some letters are taken away from the word it governs

parts.note: to nail a thief is to catch or seize him

indicators.note: the end in place is that word's final letter

explanation.surface: A choice between gluing something and nailing it into position.
explanation.walkthrough: 'missing' takes out the E found by 'end in' (last letter of place) from SEIZE.
explanation.definitionFit: Size is a thin gelatinous glue used to stiffen paper or prime plaster.

clue.text: Feller's French and in a patterned coat

parts.note: a feller of trees is a lumberjack; the 's joins it to what follows
et is the French word for and

explanation.surface: A man's French connections and his patterned coat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Feller' reads as an old spelling of fellow, but it is one who fells trees.
explanation.definitionFit: A lumberjacket is a checked woollen jacket of the kind worn by woodsmen.

clue.text: Try to date poet

parts.note: to court someone is to date them
Martial was a Roman poet famed for epigrams

explanation.surface: Attempting to go out with a poet.
explanation.definitionFit: To court-martial a soldier is to try them before a military court.

clue.text: Poison sounded alarm

indicators.note: sounded says the word for poison is said out loud, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: a toxin is a poison

explanation.surface: A poisoning set off the warning bells.
explanation.definitionFit: A tocsin is an alarm bell or warning signal.

clue.text: Reveal woman's gained weight

parts.note: Ann is a woman's name; 's gained links it to the next piece
an ounce is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: A woman discloses that she has put on weight.
explanation.definitionFit: To announce something is to make it known, to reveal it publicly.

clue.text: Version of rabble-rousing not having succeeded

indicators.note: not having says a letter is removed from the word before

parts.note: sedition is speech or conduct stirring up rebellion, rabble-rousing
S is the abbreviation for succeeded in genealogies

explanation.surface: A form of agitation that failed to win.
explanation.definitionFit: An edition is one version of a published text.

clue.text: Developed negatives, omitting middle picture

indicators.note: developed, as film is, signals the letters are worked into a new form
omitting middle says the central letter of the word is dropped

explanation.surface: Photographic negatives processed with the central frame missed out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'omitting middle' drops T, the fifth of nine letters, leaving NEGAIVES, which 'Developed' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: To envisage is to picture in the mind, to imagine.

clue.text: Stranger hoped to get put in the picture

indicators.note: stranger as an adjective means more odd, so the letters come out oddly rearranged

explanation.surface: An outsider wished to be included in the photograph.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone photoed has literally been captured in a picture.

clue.text: I invested in piped water; a pump, from the off, would be a liability

indicators.note: invested in means put inside, so one piece goes within another

parts.note: H and C, hot and cold, are the piped water marked on taps

indicators.note: from the off means take the first letter

explanation.surface: Remarks on plumbing and a water pump becoming a burden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'invested in' puts I inside H AND C.
explanation.definitionFit: A handicap is a disadvantage, a liability.

clue.text: Old flames keep silent, mostly for funeral rites

indicators.note: keep means hold inside, so one piece is held in another

parts.note: old flames are former partners, exes

indicators.note: mostly says the word loses its last letter

parts.note: silent means quiet

explanation.surface: Former lovers stay quiet throughout a funeral.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old flames' are former partners, a common idiom; 'mostly' trims the last letter of the synonym before 'keep' puts it inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Exequies are funeral rites or ceremonies.

clue.text: Nasty giant, somewhat gloomy

indicators.note: somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An unpleasant giant is rather dark in mood.
explanation.definitionFit: Stygian, from the river Styx of the underworld, means dark and gloomy.

clue.text: Hostile sextet control Northern Territory

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals
to rule is to control
NT is the abbreviation for the Australian Northern Territory

explanation.surface: Six people seize power in an Australian territory in an unfriendly takeover.
explanation.definitionFit: Virulent means bitterly hostile or malignant.

clue.text: East allowed to draw out

parts.note: licit means allowed, lawful

explanation.surface: The East is permitted to extend something.
explanation.definitionFit: To elicit is to draw out a response or information.

clue.text: Tidy up what's left on plate, not even started

indicators.note: not even started says the word loses its opening letter

parts.note: food left on a plate is uneaten

explanation.surface: Clearing up the leftovers from a meal nobody touched.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not even started' takes the first letter U off UNEATEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: making a room or desk neat is putting it in order, the same as tidying it.

clue.text: Pops in slight change to agenda

indicators.note: change says the letters before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Father pops in a small alteration to the meeting's agenda.
explanation.definitionFit: A shopping list is an agenda of things to buy, a list of items to get.

clue.text: Due to get married after first of October

indicators.note: after puts the second piece behind the first
first of says take the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: to wed is to marry; wed also means married

explanation.surface: An October wedding is overdue.
explanation.definitionFit: Owed means due, as a debt is.

clue.text: Hard-to miss national flag

indicators.note: to miss means to leave out, so a letter goes

parts.note: Irish is a nationality
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A national flag that is hard to overlook.
explanation.definitionFit: The yellow flag is a kind of iris, so flag names that plant.

clue.text: Fancy a nice rug, a great work of art?

indicators.note: fancy as a verb is imagine, signalling the letters are reimagined in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone likes a nice rug and wonders whether it is a masterpiece.
explanation.definitionFit: Guernica is Picasso's famous painting of the bombing of a Basque town.

clue.text: Gurkhas born without limits

indicators.note: without in its old sense means outside, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: née, used of a woman's maiden name, means born
pales are boundaries or limits

explanation.surface: Gurkha soldiers are born without any limits.
explanation.definitionFit: Gurkhas are soldiers recruited from Nepal, so they are Nepalese.
